metadata.description: jr mods: 42 Claude Code mods for solo builders. Context bar, plan limits, billable time, guards, dictation, business dashboards and more.

plugins.name: jr-context
plugins.description: A context bar above the prompt: what fills the window, category by category, in a stacked colour bar with a legend, free space and the compaction point.

plugins.name: jr-limits
plugins.description: Plan limits above the prompt: the 5-hour and 7-day windows as gradient gauges with reset countdowns, a toast at 80 % and 95 %, and /jrlimits for the detail.

plugins.name: jr-cache-clock
plugins.description: A prompt-cache countdown above the prompt: how long the cache stays warm after Claude's last reply, going green to red, the last cache hit rate, and a toast 30 seconds before it goes cold.

plugins.name: jr-next-cost
plugins.description: What the next prompt costs before you send it: the context it resends, at the current model's price, read from a warm cache or written to a cold one, at API rates.

plugins.name: jr-quota
plugins.description: Balances of the other paid APIs you use (OpenRouter, Firecrawl, DeepSeek), checked every 10 minutes: /jrquota shows them all, a band and a toast appear only when one runs low.

plugins.name: jr-read-cap
plugins.description: Stops Claude from reading a long file whole: a Read of a file over 1,000 lines without a range is refused with a hint to grep first and read only the lines it needs. Saves context and tokens.

plugins.name: jr-time
plugins.description: Billable time per project: every minute of a session sorted into categories, a ratio per category, an hourly rate, and an amount. /jrtime to adjust, export to CSV or Markdown.

plugins.name: jr-week
plugins.description: /jrweek: your week with Claude Code, per day and per project: time Claude worked, prompts and cost, with gradient bars and a Markdown export.

plugins.name: jr-heatmap
plugins.description: /jrheatmap: your last 26 weeks with Claude Code as a GitHub-style heatmap, with current and longest streak and your peak hours.

plugins.name: jr-wrapped
plugins.description: /jrwrapped: your month with Claude Code, Wrapped-style: prompts, hours, streak, busiest hour, top tools and projects, a persona, and a share card saved as SVG and PNG.

plugins.name: jr-stripemrr
plugins.description: Your Stripe MRR and today's revenue above the prompt, refreshed every 15 minutes; /jrmrr adds the last 30 days as a sparkline.

plugins.name: jr-visitors
plugins.description: Live visitors from PostHog above the prompt (last 5 minutes and today), refreshed every 2 minutes; /jrvisitors adds today's top pages.

plugins.name: jr-uptime
plugins.description: Pings your sites every 2 minutes; a red band above the prompt the moment one goes down, and /jruptime with latency sparklines and the last incident.

plugins.name: jr-outage
plugins.description: Is it them or is it me? The status of Claude, GitHub, npm and Vercel, checked every 10 minutes: /jroutage shows them all, a band and a toast appear only when one is degraded.

plugins.name: jr-done-check
plugins.description: Flags replies that claim something was tested or verified when nothing was run in the turn to check it: a warning under the message and a toast.

plugins.name: jr-no-promise
plugins.description: When a reply ends by announcing work ("I'll…", "Let me…", "je vais…") and no tool ran in the turn, Claude is sent back once to actually do it.

plugins.name: jr-scope
plugins.description: Warns when a turn writes sensitive files nobody asked for (lockfiles, manifests, CI, .env, migrations, infra) or too many files at once.

plugins.name: jr-commit-coach
plugins.description: Nudges you toward small atomic commits: when uncommitted changes pass a threshold, a band and a toast suggest a split by folder.

plugins.name: jr-nudges
plugins.description: At the end of a turn, one toast when the code Claude wrote added debug statements (console.log, print, debugger) or TODO/FIXME/HACK lines.

plugins.name: jr-pkg-guard
plugins.description: Checks every package install against its registry first: names that do not exist (hallucinated or typosquatted) are refused, very new packages are held back or flagged, install scripts are flagged.

plugins.name: jr-mod-audit
plugins.description: /jrmodaudit owner/repo: clones a mod, runs the official validator on each plugin in it, reads its source, and shows what it can reach with a green, amber or red verdict before you install it.

plugins.name: jr-deploy-guard
plugins.description: Production deploys and pushes to main always come to you for confirmation, even when your rules allow them. Optional: no deploys on Friday.

plugins.name: jr-explain
plugins.description: Every shell command Claude asks permission for comes with a plain-English explanation and a risk level: low, medium or high.

plugins.name: jr-redact
plugins.description: Replaces API keys, tokens, private keys and database passwords in tool results with placeholders before Claude reads them. Emails and IPs too, if you ask.

plugins.name: jr-record
plugins.description: Recording mode for demos and screen shares: /jrrec masks emails, money amounts, keys, phone numbers and IPs on screen. Claude still reads the real text.

plugins.name: jr-image-guard
plugins.description: Keeps oversized images out of the conversation: an image over 7800 px is read through a resized copy, and browser viewports over the limit are refused.

plugins.name: jr-no-ai-trailer
plugins.description: Stops commits and pull requests that carry an AI co-author line or a 'Generated with' footer, so your history stays yours.

plugins.name: jr-dictation
plugins.description: Fixes what dictation mishears ("cloud code" → Claude Code) before Claude reads your prompt, and shows each fix in your prompt row: red struck, green added.

plugins.name: jr-polish
plugins.description: /jrpolish <rough prompt>: a small fast model rewrites it into a clear, structured prompt in the same language and puts it in your prompt box to edit and send.

plugins.name: jr-draft
plugins.description: /jrdraft: a scratch pane to write your next prompt while Claude works, kept per project, sent to the prompt box when you are ready.

plugins.name: jr-deslop
plugins.description: Flags AI-writing tells (em dashes, "delve", "not X, but Y", stock openers...) in the prose files Claude writes. A toast after each file, /jrdeslop for the list. Never rewrites anything.

plugins.name: jr-vinci
plugins.description: An opt-in sparring partner: after each answer, one line above the prompt with the sharpest challenge to what was just decided. /jrvinci on, off, or the history.

plugins.name: jr-post
plugins.description: /jrpost: a short "what I built today" post drafted from this session, shown in a pane and copied to your clipboard.

plugins.name: jr-mods
plugins.description: /jrmods: every installed plugin and mod in one list. Space ticks or unticks, Enter applies all the changes at once.

plugins.name: jr-goal
plugins.description: A goal per project with steps you tick off, shown above the prompt with a progress gauge. /jrgoal to set it.

plugins.name: jr-decisions
plugins.description: A decision journal per project: /jrdecide or a prompt starting with "decision:" records one, /jrdecisions lists them and exports docs/decisions.md.

plugins.name: jr-todo
plugins.description: /jrtodo <task>: capture a task instantly, with no model call, to TODO.md, Todoist, Linear, Notion, a GitHub issue, Things, Apple Reminders, or your own command.

plugins.name: jr-outputs
plugins.description: /jroutputs: every file this session created or changed, newest first, with + and - line counts from git.

plugins.name: jr-fleet
plugins.description: Every Claude Code session on this machine at a glance: which ones are working and which ones wait for you, in a band above the prompt and in /jrfleet.

plugins.name: jr-badge
plugins.description: A coloured badge above the prompt naming the project, its branch and folder, so you always know which window you are typing in. A `badge: LABEL #hex` line in CLAUDE.md sets your own.

plugins.name: jr-done-ping
plugins.description: A notification, and a sound on macOS, when a long turn finishes: work in another window and come back when Claude is done. Names the project and how long it took.

plugins.name: jr-awake
plugins.description: Keeps the Mac awake while Claude works, shared by every session on the machine, and warns before the next sleep.
